quote: Knowledge Editing. KE aims to transform the behavior of the original model f base into postedit model f e . Given an edit descriptor z e = (x e , r e , y e ), where (x e , r e , y e ) represents a triplet such as (US, President, Joe Biden) meaning Joe Biden is the president of US. KE ensures that f e (x e , r e ) = y e while f base (x e , r e ) ̸ = y e . A thorough edit not only modifies the corresponding knowledge but also all the knowledge within the multi-hop relations that are impacted by this edit.
We conduct extensive experiments using the MQUAKE-3K dataset ... to evaluate KE on counterfactual edits. ... The model generates edited answers to multi‑hop knowledge questions.
With the widespread deployment of large language models (LLMs), there is a rising demand for accessing accurate information through LLMs.
outputs: Generated answers to multi-hop questions based on edited knowledge

Generated answers to multi-hop questions involving edited knowledge, such as country of citizenship, official language, or birthplace based on in-context edited facts.
